program: const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, '''); const n = evidence.length; const pad = 10; const w = n > 0 ? Math.floor((640 - pad * (n + 1)) / n) : 0; const h = 220; let cards = ''; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const r = evidence[i]; const x = pad + i * (w + pad); const y = pad; const labelText = r.label != null ? esc(r.label) : 'Not supplied'; const varText = r.variable != null ? esc(r.variable) : 'Not supplied'; const valText = r.value != null ? esc(String(r.value)) : 'Not supplied'; const unitText = r.unit != null ? esc(String(r.unit)) : 'Unit not supplied'; cards += '<g data-record-id="' + esc(r.id) + '" transform="translate(' + x + ',' + y + ')"><rect x="0" y="0" width="' + w + '" height="' + h + '" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cccccc"/><text x="10" y="30" fill="#000000">' + labelText + '</text><text x="10" y="60" fill="#555555">' + varText + '</text><text x="10" y="90" fill="#333333">' + valText + '</text><text x="10" y="120" fill="#777777">' + unitText + '</text></g>'; } return '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 240"><rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="240" fill="#f0f0f0"/>' + cards + '</svg>';
